title: CERN Openlab Summer Internship
desc: Hands-on computing and engineering internship with stipend, travel support, and accommodation assistance.
overview: The CERN Openlab Summer Internship offers students practical exposure to real-world scientific computing and engineering projects at CERN. Interns work with international teams and gain access to world-class research infrastructure.
eligibility: Open to undergraduate and master's students in relevant fields such as Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, and related disciplines. Applicants should have strong academic records and basic programming/research skills.
benefits: Includes monthly stipend, travel support, and accommodation guidance. Selected interns receive mentorship from CERN experts and certification upon successful completion.
documents: Updated CV, academic transcripts, statement of purpose, recommendation letter(s), passport details, and any relevant project portfolio.
steps: Create account on official portal, complete application form, upload required documents, submit before deadline, and monitor email for shortlist/interview instructions.
notes: Only complete applications with all documents are reviewed. Early submission is strongly recommended.

title: Echoing Green Global Fellowship
desc: Two-year social impact fellowship with seed funding, leadership coaching, and long-term network access.
overview: Echoing Green Fellowship supports emerging social entrepreneurs solving critical global challenges. Fellows receive long-term capacity-building support and access to a global network.
eligibility: Open to early-stage leaders with innovative social impact ideas. Applicants can be from any country but must demonstrate measurable impact potential.
benefits: Includes seed grant funding, leadership development, strategic mentorship, and networking opportunities with global impact leaders.
documents: Project proposal, founder bio, impact plan, organizational information, budget estimate, and optional recommendation material.
steps: Register on official portal, submit organizational and founder details, provide impact model and budget, complete interview rounds if shortlisted.
notes: Strong clarity on problem-solution fit and measurable outcomes improves selection chances.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
desc: Graduate-level scholarship covering tuition, monthly stipend, health insurance, and round-trip travel.
overview: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program supports outstanding international students for master's or doctoral study and research in the United States.
eligibility: Applicants must meet country-specific eligibility criteria, hold strong academic records, and demonstrate leadership potential.
benefits: Covers tuition fees, living stipend, health insurance, travel allowance, and academic enrichment opportunities.
documents: Academic transcripts, degree certificates, CV, statement of purpose, study/research objectives, recommendation letters, and language test scores as required.
steps: Check your country Fulbright office requirements, prepare documents, submit online application, attend interviews, and complete nomination process.
notes: Requirements vary by country. Always follow your national Fulbright commission instructions.

title: Erasmus Mundus MESPOM Scholarship 2027/29
desc: Fully funded Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's programme in Environmental Sciences, Policy and Management, with study periods across European partner universities.
overview: The Erasmus Mundus MESPOM programme is a two-year international master's degree focused on environmental sciences, policy and management. Students study across partner universities in Europe and can receive an Erasmus Mundus scholarship covering major study and living-related expenses.
eligibility: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification and meet the MESPOM programme's academic and English-language requirements. Candidates from around the world may apply, subject to the programme's specific eligibility criteria.
benefits: Erasmus Mundus scholarship holders receive €1,400 per month for the scholarship period, together with support contributing to travel, visa, installation and subsistence costs. Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover the full duration of the master's programme, subject to the applicable funding rules.
documents: Academic transcripts, degree certificate or proof of expected graduation, CV, motivation or personal statement, recommendation letters, proof of English-language proficiency, and other documents required by the MESPOM application system.
steps: Review the MESPOM admission and scholarship requirements, prepare the required academic and supporting documents, complete the online application, select the Erasmus Mundus scholarship option where applicable, and submit the application before the scholarship deadline.
notes: MESPOM is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master programme. Erasmus Mundus scholarships are competitive and awarded to the highest-ranked eligible applicants. Applicants should verify the final 2027/29 deadline and requirements on the official MESPOM application website before submitting.

country: Germany, Spain, United Kingdom, Belgium, Portugal & Estonia
title: Erasmus Mundus ILSPSD Scholarship 2027
desc: Fully funded two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's programme in International Law of Security, Peace and Sustainable Development, delivered across six European partner universities.
funding: €1,400/month for 24 months + tuition exemption + travel + visa + installation + subsistence + insurance
overview: The Erasmus Mundus ILSPSD is a two-year international master's programme combining international law with security, peace, sustainable development, human rights, politics and global governance. Students study in at least three European countries and complete specialised coursework and a dissertation.
eligibility: Applicants must hold a completed undergraduate degree from a fully accredited higher education institution, with at least 180 ECTS or an equivalent qualification that provides access to master's-level study in the country where the degree was awarded. Applicants must also meet the academic and English-language requirements of their selected study track. Additional French-language proficiency may be required for the Brussels track.
benefits: Selected Erasmus Mundus scholarship recipients receive €1,400 per month for up to 24 months, tuition fee exemption, contributions toward travel, visa and installation costs, subsistence support, and health and accident insurance.
documents: University entrance qualification or school-leaving certificate, bachelor's degree certificate, academic transcripts, personal statement, two reference letters, CV/resume, English-language proof, French-language proof if required for the Brussels track, and any additional documents required by the selected study track.
steps: Review the ILSPSD programme structure and entry requirements, choose the study track that matches your academic background, prepare the required documents, select your first, second and third track preferences where applicable, complete the online application, and submit the application before the Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline.
notes: The 2027–2029 programme lasts 24 months and includes mobility across European partner universities. The scholarship application deadline is 4 January 2027 at 23:59 CET. Self-funded applicants have a separate deadline of 31 March 2027. Scholarship selection is competitive and applicants should verify the final requirements on the official application portal.

title: IMF Economist Program 2027
desc: A three-year rotational career programme for recent PhD economists, offering substantive work across country analysis, macroeconomic policy, research, and capacity development at IMF Headquarters in Washington, D.C.
funding: Paid economist position + IMF employee benefits
overview: The IMF Economist Program (EP) is a three-year career programme designed for recent PhD economists and candidates within one year of completing their PhD. Participants are hired as economists and complete two departmental assignments, gaining hands-on experience in international economic policy, country work, research, and capacity development.
eligibility: Applicants must be recent PhD graduates in economics or a related field, or be within one year of completing their PhD. Candidates must be under 34 years of age when the programme begins in September 2027, be citizens of an IMF member country, demonstrate strong analytical and quantitative skills, and have excellent written and spoken English.
benefits: Participants are hired as IMF economists and receive the compensation and benefits associated with IMF employment. The programme provides substantive professional experience, exposure to different IMF departments and policy areas, opportunities to work on international economic issues, and a potential pathway to continued employment as an IMF economist after successful completion.
documents: CV/resume, academic transcripts, research paper, three academic references, and other information or documents requested through the IMF application system.
steps: Review the official IMF Economist Program requirements, confirm that you meet the PhD and age requirements, prepare your CV and academic documents, submit the online application through the IMF careers portal, participate in preliminary interviews and assessments if shortlisted, and complete the panel interview process.
notes: The Economist Program is a paid career programme, not a scholarship or internship. The 2027 cohort is scheduled to begin in September 2027. The IMF's official recruitment information states that Economist Program advertisements for the following year's intake are posted in late September and applications close in December.

title: Leadership and Peace Summit Morocco 2027
org: School of Leadership and Diplomacy (SLD) | Morocco
desc: International leadership and peace summit bringing together students, young professionals, emerging leaders, changemakers, peace advocates, and individuals interested in diplomacy and global cooperation.
funding: 10 fully funded seats + 60 partially funded seats + 70 free access passes
overview: The Leadership & Peace Summit Morocco 2027 is an international summit focused on leadership, peacebuilding, diplomacy, international relations, conflict resolution, cultural diversity, youth leadership, global cooperation, and sustainable development. The event is scheduled to take place from 29 to 31 January 2027 in Morocco.
eligibility: The summit is particularly relevant to university students, young professionals, emerging leaders, youth activists, changemakers, peace advocates, individuals interested in diplomacy, community leaders, people working toward positive social change, and participants interested in international cooperation and leadership.
benefits: For the 10 fully funded delegates, benefits include roundtrip travel compensation/reimbursement, 100% conference fee waiver, accommodation for the program period on a twin-sharing basis, meals twice per day, certificate of participation, conference kit, cultural exchange program, celebration party, and recognition awards. Additional participation categories include partially funded, self-funded, and free access places.
documents: The source page does not provide a complete list of required application documents. Applicants should check the official registration/application page for the current eligibility criteria, application requirements, and participation category requirements.
steps: Visit the official registration page, review the eligibility criteria and available participation categories, prepare the required application information and documents, pay the stated $23 application fee if applicable, and submit the application before 15 October 2026.
notes: The summit has 150 seats worldwide: 10 fully funded, 60 partially funded, 60 self-funded, and 70 free access passes. The application fee is $23. The venue is currently listed as to be announced. Because the fully funded places are limited to 10 delegates, applicants should not interpret the event title as meaning that every selected participant receives full funding. The source page links to an Eventbrite registration page rather than providing a detailed official SLD application portal.

title: Aspire Leaders Program 2026 (Cohort 4)
funding: Free program with no application fee, free certificate of completion
summary: A free, fully online 6-week leadership program for first-generation and limited-income university students and recent graduates worldwide.
overview:
The Aspire Leaders Program is a free, fully online and self-paced leadership program founded at Harvard and now run by Aspire Institute. It is designed for first-generation and limited-income university students and recent graduates from around the world.

The 6-week program includes live masterclasses with global faculty and experts, and gives you access to a global network of students and mentors.
eligibility: First-generation and limited-income university students and recent graduates worldwide, aged 18 to 29.
benefits:
100% free with no application fee.
Fully online and self-paced, over 6 weeks.
Live masterclasses with global faculty and experts.
A global network of students and mentors.
Free certificate of completion.
After the program, alumni can continue through seed funds, mentorship sessions and a global peer network, according to the official website.
steps:
Open the official Aspire Leaders website
Use the Apply button for the 2026 Aspire Leaders Program, Cohort 4
Complete and submit your application before 16 October 2026
notes: Applications close on 16 October 2026 and the program runs from 21 October to 30 November 2026. The program is free, so never pay anyone who offers to guarantee you a place. Apply early rather than on the last day.

title: Salzburg Global Internship 2027
desc: International internship opportunity offering practical experience with Salzburg Global in areas including programs, development, communications, and library work.
funding: Room and board + return travel + insurance; internship is unpaid
deadline: Not clearly stated on the official page
overview: Salzburg Global offers internships in Salzburg for a maximum of three months. Interns work with international teams and support programs covering areas such as health, education, culture, peace and justice, finance, and governance.
eligibility: Applicants must be at least 18 years old. Program or Development Internship applicants may be undergraduate students completing a bachelor's degree or recent graduates with relevant interests. Strong English communication, organizational skills, initiative, and the ability to work in an international environment are expected.
benefits: Salzburg-based interns receive board and lodging at Schloss Leopoldskron, a return ticket to their country of origin, and insurance. Visa-processing assistance is also provided.
documents: CV/resume, cover letter, and any additional materials requested for the specific internship position.
steps: Visit the official Salzburg Global internship page, review available internship positions, prepare the required documents, complete the official online application, and submit the application during the relevant application period.
notes: The internship is unpaid. Salzburg Global provides accommodation, meals, return travel, and insurance support. Applicants should verify the current application period and deadline on the official website.

title: Cultural Futures Forum 2027: Whose Creative Labor Counts?
desc: International forum exploring how AI, automation, digital platforms, and changing labor markets are reshaping cultural and creative work.
funding: Limited full and partial scholarships covering participation costs and, for selected applicants, travel support
overview: The Cultural Futures Forum will take place in Salzburg from 14 to 19 March 2027. The forum explores recognition, equity, workforce futures, and changing conditions in cultural and creative labor.
eligibility: Open to people working in or connected to the cultural and creative sector, including artists, cultural practitioners, policymakers, researchers, funders, creative entrepreneurs, educators, technology professionals, and other changemakers.
benefits: Selected participants may receive full or partial scholarships covering participation costs and travel support. Participants also gain international networking, peer learning, and access to the residential forum at Schloss Leopoldskron.
documents: Personal and professional information, CV or professional details, written application responses, video response, and financial-support information where applicable.
steps: Review the official Cultural Futures Forum information, complete the online application, answer the required questions, indicate financial-support requirements if applicable, and submit before the deadline.
notes: This is not fully funded for every participant. Salzburg Global offers a limited number of full scholarships and additional partial scholarships.

title: HSC Youth Ambassador Program 2027
desc: Fully funded youth leadership opportunity for young community leaders from Global South countries to participate in the Hamburg Sustainability Conference.
overview: The HSC Youth Ambassador Program brings young sustainability leaders into the Hamburg Sustainability Conference as active contributors to panels, workshops, moderations, and high-level discussions.
eligibility: Applicants must be 18 to 30 years old, come from and currently reside in an eligible Global South country, demonstrate sustainability leadership and community impact, communicate confidently in English, and be available for the required preparatory activities and the Hamburg Sustainability Conference in 2027.
benefits: Travel and accommodation are covered. Youth Ambassadors participate in conference sessions, engage with international leaders, take part in the HSC Youth Roundtable Series, and receive opportunities for international networking.
documents: Online application form, personal and academic or professional information, sustainability leadership responses, LinkedIn profile, and optional links demonstrating previous work.
steps: Open the official HSC Youth Ambassador application form, complete the required information, answer the sustainability and leadership questions, provide supporting links where applicable, and submit before the deadline.
notes: Previous participation in international conferences or youth programs is not mandatory. The program focuses on young community leaders with demonstrated sustainability-related action and impact.

title: Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarship 2027-2028
desc: Highly competitive full scholarship for non-EU/EEA students admitted to participating master's programmes at Maastricht University.
funding: Full tuition + living expenses + health and liability insurance + visa costs + pre-academic training + accommodation support
overview: The Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarship provides 18 full scholarships each academic year to highly talented students from outside the EU/EEA who are admitted to eligible full-time master's programmes.
eligibility: Applicants must be nationals of countries outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and Surinam, meet the relevant visa requirements, apply for an eligible full-time master's programme for 2027-2028, complete the master's admission application by 10 December 2026, be no older than 35 on 1 September 2027, and normally have a GPA equivalent to at least 7.5 out of 10.
benefits: The scholarship provides living expenses, tuition fees, health and liability insurance, visa application costs, pre-academic training costs, and accommodation support according to the scholarship conditions.
documents: CV, scholarship motivation letter, academic transcript or official GPA document, grading-system explanation, personal statement of financial need, reference letter, and referee contact details.
steps: Apply first to an eligible Maastricht University master's programme through Studielink and complete the admission file by 10 December 2026. After receiving a UM student ID, complete the official scholarship application and submit it by 1 February 2027.
notes: Only 18 scholarships are awarded, making the scholarship highly competitive. Applicants can submit only one scholarship application and must also satisfy the admission requirements of their selected master's programme.

title: EPFL Summer Research Program 2027
org: EPFL School of Life Sciences | Switzerland
desc: Eight-week summer research program for international students in eligible life-sciences-related bachelor's and early master's programs.
funding: CHF 3,600 stipend + housing support + travel reimbursement up to CHF 1,000 for overseas flights or CHF 500 for shorter-distance travel
overview: The EPFL School of Life Sciences Summer Research Program provides an eight-week research experience from 5 July to 27 August 2027. Participants work with research groups, receive mentoring, attend scientific seminars and workshops, and present their research at a closing symposium.
eligibility: Applicants must be enrolled in a university degree program related to biology, biophysics, chemistry, bioengineering, bioinformatics, quantitative biology, genetics, medical sciences, or another eligible life-sciences-related field. Applicants must have completed at least two years of undergraduate study and meet the required academic standard.
benefits: Participants receive CHF 3,600 for the two-month program, housing support, and travel reimbursement up to the specified limits. The program also provides laboratory research experience, faculty mentoring, scientific seminars, workshops, and research presentation experience.
documents: University transcript, personal and scientific essays, referee details, recommendation letter, and laboratory-choice information.
steps: Review the official EPFL Summer Research Program requirements, prepare the required essays and transcript, select preferred participating laboratories, provide referee information, complete the online application, and submit it before the deadline.
notes: This specific EPFL program is for Life Sciences and related fields. It is not a general Computer Science summer internship. Applicants must remain enrolled in an eligible degree program during the program.
